credentials.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
credentials.label: Claude Code — API billing
credentials.fix: API billing — do not combine with the subscription token. Billed per token, not against a subscription.
credentials.note: Silently outranks CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN: if both are set, this key wins and you are billed API usage. Set one or the other, never both.

credentials.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
credentials.label: Claude Code — Pro/Max subscription (recommended)
credentials.fix: On your laptop: run `claude setup-token`, sign in, paste the printed token here.
credentials.note: Uses your Claude subscription, no per-token billing. Make sure ANTHROPIC_API_KEY stays unset — it silently outranks this token.

credentials.name: XAI_API_KEY
credentials.label: grok — API billing
credentials.fix: Paste an xAI API key, or run `grok login --device-auth` over SSH for a subscription.

credentials.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
credentials.label: Gemini
credentials.fix: Paste a Google AI Studio key.
credentials.note: UNVERIFIED that the Gemini CLI reads this name — see the report.

credentials.name: GH_TOKEN
credentials.label: GitHub CLI
credentials.fix: Paste a PAT, or run `gh auth login --with-token` over SSH.

credentials.name: GIT_AUTHOR_NAME
